interpretations: For each matched `orderslink` and side, average `feerate - rebrate` over records with both values present; count all matched fee records in the group. Compare that average with the unweighted average of group averages for the same side.

For each matched `orderslink` and side, average `feerate - rebrate` over records with both values present; count only records that contribute to that average. Compare it with the unweighted average of group averages for the same side.

For each matched `orderslink` and side, subtract the average nonmissing `rebrate` from the average `feerate`; count all matched fee records in the group. Compare the result with the unweighted average of group results for the same side.

For each matched `orderslink` and side, subtract the average nonmissing `rebrate` from the average `feerate`; count only records with both values present. Compare the result with the unweighted average of group results for the same side.
queries:
WITH fee_groups AS (
    SELECT
        f.orderslink,
        o.dealedge AS side,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN f.feerate IS NOT NULL AND f.rebrate IS NOT NULL
            THEN f.feerate - f.rebrate
        END) AS avg_net_rate,
        COUNT(*) AS fee_count
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
    GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge
)
SELECT
    orderslink,
    side,
    avg_net_rate,
    fee_count,
    AVG(avg_net_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY side) AS side_avg_of_group_averages
FROM fee_groups

WITH group_rates AS (
    SELECT
        f.orderslink,
        o.dealedge AS side,
        AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_rate,
        COUNT(*) AS contributing_count
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
    WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL
      AND f.rebrate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge
)
SELECT
    orderslink,
    side,
    avg_net_rate,
    contributing_count,
    AVG(avg_net_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY side) AS side_avg_of_group_averages
FROM group_rates

WITH fee_groups AS (
    SELECT
        f.orderslink,
        o.dealedge AS side,
        AVG(f.feerate) - AVG(f.rebrate) AS rate_difference,
        COUNT(*) AS fee_count
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o
      ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
    GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge
)
SELECT
    orderslink,
    side,
    rate_difference,
    fee_count,
    AVG(rate_difference) OVER (PARTITION BY side) AS side_average
FROM fee_groups

WITH group_results AS (
    SELECT
        f.orderslink,
        o.dealedge AS side,
        AVG(f.feerate) - AVG(f.rebrate) AS rate_difference
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
    WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL
      AND f.rebrate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge
)
SELECT
    orderslink,
    side,
    rate_difference,
    AVG(rate_difference) OVER (PARTITION BY side) AS side_average
FROM group_results
